metadata.description: Phase 3: Android props, I/O pod, Flutter player app with roles, new game modes (Kill Confirmed, Respawn, Player Check-in, Money Factory), chrono check-in. Plan phases A, B, C, D, E (with the Android controller role's slices S1-S6, S7a, S7b, S7c and the rest of S7: the role done in software) and F (in software) implemented.

plan_phases.A: done in software (2026-10-18): events, Kill Confirmed, Respawn, Player Check-in, player tags, capability proxy v1, screen templates; decisions A1-A13
plan_phases.B: done in software (2026-10-19): chrono data model, energy, limit templates (unverified), spot checks, Ed25519-signed records, player tags and player tokens in Dart; shared vectors chrono_record.json and player_token.json checked in Dart and Python; decisions B1-B13
plan_phases.C: done in software (2026-10-19): dart:ffi bindings, isolate-local callbacks, game loop isolate, FFI stub with layout report, every mode test through the Dart bridge, Android NDK build (three ABIs) via CMake presets and Gradle, CI jobs flutter-test, core-android-ndk, flutter-build-android; core fix in field.common_owner; decisions PC1-PC11
plan_phases.D: done in software (2026-10-19): Flutter screen-template renderer checked against the core, Android prop shell (modes on the core, team buttons, keypad, NFC tags, game timer sending game.end, admin PIN, screen manager, kiosk and tamper), join by QR/NFC/text, player view on the controller feed, GM web view, marshal chrono/replicas/tag writer, pt-PT and English, Kotlin plugins (device, kiosk, foreground service, NFC, QR with CameraX+ZXing, USB and BLE pod), pod codec and client, CI job flutter-integration (emulator, not run locally); iOS not built; core fix in |clock; decisions PD1-PD24
plan_phases.E: done in software (2026-10-19), with the Android controller role in slices S1-S6 (2026-10-22; PE24): field check-in (poster, identities, tokens with the controller's own per-game key, declarations, replicas-to-chrono list fed by signed readings, retention), HTTPS with the field CA, role-filtered stream with the event history in hello, Android props on Wi-Fi (join keys 13 and 14), player positions with server-side visibility, teams and squads (PE25), GM console Check-in tab and poster, the app's screens; Dart MQTT broker and visibility engine; decisions PE1-PE25. The Android controller role in slices (PLAN.md, PE24 slices; decisions PE24-1 to PE24-15 and PE24-40 on): S1 done in software 2026-10-22 (the game engine with field.lua on the core and the REST API, shared contract cases protocol/vectors/controller_api.json passing against the Pi and the Dart controller); S2 done in software 2026-10-22 (WS /api/v1/stream with the Pi's hello, order and token filtering, the Pi bridge's MQTT topics and payloads on the embedded broker with logins and the Pi's ACL, stream and MQTT steps in the shared cases on both sides); S3 done in software 2026-10-22 (FileControllerStore: games, log, scores, nodes and settings in files; the restart as the Pi's, the key kept only with persist_game_key, else key_lost; restart steps in the shared cases, 17 cases on both sides; the controller's own event seq after a restart fixed in both controllers, PE24-42); decisions PE24-40 to PE24-44; S4 done in software 2026-10-22 (an I/O pod as the radio through its RADIO_* frames, a TX epoch per game key, joins sealed with the field join key, WS /api/v1/prop for Android props on Wi-Fi; radio, join and prop steps in the shared cases, 21 cases on both sides; end-to-end tests with the host pod and host boxes; the channel choice moved to S7); decisions PE24-45 to PE24-53; S5 done in software 2026-10-22 (field check-in, player tokens with a per-game key checked against the check-in, signed chrono readings and the replicas-to-chrono list, player positions with the Pi's visibility rules and the level kept, player tokens on the API and the stream; kept as documents of the store; wall_start, bearer and ws_closed in the shared cases, 28 cases on both sides; the Pi's poster settings checked with HTTPS off, PE24-58); decisions PE24-54 to PE24-60 (PE24-60 answered by the maintainer: as on the Pi, app-private storage); S6 done in software 2026-10-22 (the shell and its screen: the controller role on the home screen, Android only; its own isolate with the store, engine, check-in, positions, API, broker and tick, an I/O pod relayed from the UI isolate; the foreground service with its wake and Wi-Fi locks and the Flutter engine kept past the activity; the GM console copied into the APK at build time from controller/console/src and checked byte for byte, served on the loopback address to the app's web view; a field CA made on the phone (ECDSA P-256, pointycastle) with the poster's ca_sha256 and join keys 13 and 14; HTTPS and MQTT on the field's Wi-Fi when opened; the field's Wi-Fi, hotspot and a local-only hotspot; tested on the real core, sockets and TLS and with fakes for the phone; an emulator test for CI; not on a phone); decisions PE24-61 to PE24-69; S7a done in software 2026-10-23, pulled forward by the maintainer (the field plan: plans per level, levels, map positions, map features with the boundary and their visibility, the field from a map, the boxes' places, kept as one store document and plan files; the radio channel's choice and noise scan through the I/O pod; whoami names radio and field; a field_and_radio block of 6 shared cases, 35 on both sides); decisions PE24-74 to PE24-79; S7c done in software 2026-10-23, pulled forward from S7 with the maintainer's approval (boxes over the radio on the phone controller: free boxes, DISCOVER, sealed radio invites paced by air time with retries and answers, HELLO, the previous game; GAME_OVER after every game by its key's tag, also after a restart without the key; the start guard with Start anyway and the firmware guard; adoption by field card, written by the phone's own NFC, and by pairing code with CPace over LoRa; no USB adoption on a phone; firmware updates with signed releases, release keys in the app, CMD update, the boxes fetching over the phone's HTTPS with the S6 field CA, reports and node.update_failed; the Pi's USB radio modem as the phone's radio, told from a pod by its answer; the I/O pod relays field frames (pod firmware, PE24-100 to PE24-104; field_frames = YES in the pod IDENT); whoami features boxes, adoption, firmware; field and pair frame steps in the shared cases, 45 cases on both sides; end-to-end tests with the host modem, host boxes and host pod); decisions PE24-90 to PE24-99; S7b done in software 2026-10-23 (pulled forward by the maintainer: presets, mode uploads and signed mode packages with the [modes] settings in the app, the modes sent to boxes with the HELLO rule of P5D-14 to P5D-18 and join keys 16 and 17, also through S7c's radio invites, scenarios with the validator and compiler ported to Dart (scenario.json and the new scenario_compile.json), role packages in a game, team branding with images checked as the Pi does; whoami features presets, branding, scenarios, mode_packages; 11 new shared cases, 56 on both sides); decisions PE24-80 to PE24-89; the rest of S7 done in software 2026-10-23, pulled forward by the maintainer (failover: the CLAIM election ported from election.py, a phone and a Pi each the other's standby through a join of kind controller, promote and automatic failover, field.lua taken over; the site sync: sync_format.py and sync_client.py ported, every body checked against sync.json, offline first, the chrono registry, game day with the schedule, rosters and outcomes, branding and the scenario library from the site; the remote GM's stream, commands and log; the ATAK feed byte for byte, multicast without a multicast lock, staff TCP, the relay; settings in the app; whoami features failover, schedule, atak: the Pi's whole set; a block s7 of 4 shared cases, 63 on both sides; end-to-end tests against a site server, a WebSocket and UDP and TCP listeners in the tests; two Pi bugs fixed in both: a restarted standby's term, nodes that said HELLO never synced); decisions PE24-118 to PE24-129
plan_phases.F: done in software (2026-10-19): I/O pod firmware variant (CONFIG_ATALAIA_POD_MODE, sdkconfig.pod), proxy, USB-Serial-JTAG and NimBLE GATT links, the Field Box HAL as capabilities, radio passthrough with the modem's code (RADIO_NOISE 0x0B), node.tamper from an enclosure switch, the host pod; the phone's radio link through a pod and DualLink with Wi-Fi; not run on a board or a phone; decisions PF1-PF15
plan_phases.G: pending (needs hardware: boards, pods, phones, the Pi)
